design_philosophy.core_concept: Precision meets Exploration. A clean-room aesthetic that treats data as the protagonist. High-contrast scientific visualization against a sterile, trustworthy background.
principles: Data Density over Decoration: Every pixel must serve the mission.
Asymmetry for Tension: Use the 'Bento' grid to break monotony.
Tactile Controls: Buttons and toggles should feel physical (1px borders, subtle shadows).
Event-Driven Motion: UI elements react instantly, mimicking the neuromorphic sensors.

usage_rules: Background must be #F8F9FA (Lab White), NOT pure white.
Cards/Containers must be #FFFFFF (Pure White) with a 1px border #E2E8F0.
Primary Blue (#0055FF) is for active states and primary data streams.
Signal Orange (#FF5F00) is for alerts, 'Record' buttons, and critical event spikes.
NEVER use gradients for backgrounds. Use flat, clean colors.

structure.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-slate-200 bg-white h-screen fixed left-0 top-0 z-40

buttons.primary: bg-[#0055FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0044CC] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all
buttons.destructive: bg-white text-red-600 border border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium

cards.base: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] overflow-hidden
cards.header: px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 flex justify-between items-center bg-white

inputs.base: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all outline-none

visualizations.3d_viewport: w-full h-full rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-slate-950 relative

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for dropdowns/modals. No large diffuse shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for floating toolbars over the 3D view: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grid patterns (CSS radial-gradient) on the dashboard background to imply 'blueprint'.

components: Canvas: Set shadows and camera properly.
Points: For visualizing the Event Cloud (neuromorphic data). Use a custom shader or PointsMaterial with size attenuation.
Terrain: Use a PlaneGeometry with displacement map using the Mars/Moon textures.
3d_strategy.instructions: The 3D view is the hero. It must look scientific. Use a dark background (#0F172A) for the 3D canvas ONLY, to make the event points (which are usually bright) pop. The rest of the app remains light.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. CLEANUP: Remove all dark mode styles from index.css and App.css. Enforce the Light Mode palette defined above.
2. FONTS: Install Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts import in index.css.
3. LAYOUT: Implement the Sidebar + Main Content layout. The Sidebar should be fixed.
4. DASHBOARD: Use the Bento Grid (Mode B) for the main dashboard. High density, no wasted space.
5. 3D VIEW: Create a 'SimulationViewport' component using React Three Fiber. It should render a terrain (using the provided image URLs as textures) and a 'Lander' object.
6. CHARTS: Use Recharts for the 'Performance Metrics' (Latency, Drift). Style them to match the palette (Blue/Orange).
7. AI TOGGLE: Create a prominent toggle switch for 'AI Analysis' in the top bar. It should trigger a UI state change (e.g., highlighting anomalies).
8. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles).
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts. Use the Bento grid.
Micro-interactions: Add hover states to everything. Buttons should lift slightly.
Accessibility: Ensure text contrast is high (Slate-900 on White).
Code Quality: Use functional components, hooks, and clean prop drilling or context.
